question: Fed Rate Cut in 2026?
description:
This market will settle to Yes if the United States Federal Reserve decreases the upper bound of the target range for the federal funds rate by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Outcome sourced from the Federal Reserve.

Rate changes taken at scheduled FOMC meetings or at unscheduled or emergency meetings will both qualify.

question: NBA Eastern Conference Champion
description: This market will settle to Yes if the Miami Heat win the 2027 NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.

question: 2027 NBA Champion
description: This market will settle to Yes if the Philadelphia 76ers win the 2027 NBA Finals. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.

question: NFL Last Undefeated Team
description: This market will settle to Yes if the Chicago Bears are the last remaining team without a loss in the 2026 Pro Football regular season. If two or more teams record their first loss in the same week and no other team remains without a loss, or if two or more teams finish the regular season without a loss, each such team's market will settle at $1.00 divided by the number of tied teams. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.

question: Oakland Mayoral Election Winner
description:
This market will settle to Yes if Barbara Lee wins the 2026 election for Mayor of Oakland. Outcome sourced from relevant government authorities.

The determination of the winner includes any runoff, tiebreak, or other relevant procedure under the applicable rules of the relevant jurisdiction.

question: Justin Herbert
description: This market will settle to Yes if Justin Herbert records the most passing touchdowns among all players in Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season. If two or more players tie, each tied player's market will settle at $1.00 divided by the number of tied players. If the listed player does not play for any reason, the market will settle to No. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.
